info.title: VAT & Tax ID Validator
info.description: VAT & Tax ID Validator validates European VAT identification numbers against the real, published per-country rules: ISO 7064 MOD 11,10 product checks, Luhn, MOD 97 / 89 / 23 / 37, weighted mod-11 tests and letter check-digit tables. The hard part — and our moat — is the catalogue of 30 country-specific checksum algorithms, which most simple validators skip in favour of a plain regex. It returns the normalized number together with separate format and checksum verdicts, and can even generate the correct check digits from a partial number. Built for e-commerce tax engines, ERP/accounting integrations and fintech KYC/onboarding flows.

get.summary: Validate a VAT / Tax ID number
get.description: Validate a VAT number for a supported country. Returns the normalized number, a format verdict and — where a public algorithm exists — a checksum verdict.
